Profile summary

Principal Backend Engineer with 10.6 years of experience in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices.

Currently employed at Backbase, focusing on cloud-based microservice design and development.

Sun/Oracle Certified Web Component Developer (SCWCD/OCEJWCD). ● Sun/Oracle Certified Professional Java Programmer (SCJP/OCPJP). ● Good in Data Structures and Algorithms and follows SOLID Principles. ● Awarded Best Performer Awards multiple times at Indian Eagle, Sonetel, Globallogic, and Backbase for innovative solutions.

Technical Skills

Architecture Pattern: Monolithic, Microservices ● Spring Framework:

IoC, MVC, WebFlux, AOP, JPA, JDBC, Security, Transactions, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, REST, Config Server, Web Client, Spring Data, Actuator, OAuth2

Employed since July 1, 2021, to the present (4 years and ongoing).

Globallogic

Worked from July 23, 2020, to June 30, 2021 (1 year).

Sonetel



Worked from May 14, 2018, to July 20, 2020 (2 years and 2 months). Indian Eagle Worked from February 9, 2015, to May 4, 2018 (3 years and 3 months).

Projects Detail

Backbase:

Backbase is a leading engagement banking provider that helps banks modernize and orchestrate all customer touchpoints. It transforms siloed banking channels and legacy applications into a cohesive and deeply engaging banking experience.

1. Project summary: Worked with multiple banks (BNCR, BIAT, FRG, MCB, NBB, LIB, SKB, SBK, SBSA, ILA, GFT, DSK, Hellenic) to design, architect, and develop Spring Boot-based microservices to meet their requirements. Provided solutions for challenging cases where the requirements were difficult to achieve with the existing out-of-the-box products. Roles played: Principal software developer Team Size: 8 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to analyzing the Backbase product in conjunction with the customer's existing products and requirements. Based on this analysis, designed the entire project architecture, including the number of services to be created and the communication strategy between them. Assisted customers with multiple proofs of concept prior to actual implementation, providing examples for reference during the real service deployment. Technologies used: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, SQL, JPA, Stream, Docker, Kubernetes, git action, Keycloak, argoCD, openAPI, maven.



ICIMS:

It is a recruitment platform used by many organizations to streamline their hiring processes. It helps organizations identify candidates from various sources, schedule letters, and perform many other recruitment-related tasks.

www.app.sonetel.com

It is an online tool used for AI-based CRM, team collaboration, AI-powered chat and call bots, and a global phone system.

1. Project summary: Integration with Facebook, Twitter, Email.

Roles played: Developer Team Size: 2 Responsibilities: Actively contributed integrating our chat application with to Facebook pages, Twitter accounts, and email addresses, ensuring that messages sent to these platforms are automatically received in our chat application. Additionally, enabled messages from our app to be forwarded to the respective social media channels. Technology used: Spring REST service, mongo DB, eureka, config-server, feign, kafka, pinpoint, Jenkins etc 2. Project summary: Chat application.

Roles played: Developer Team Size: 3 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to integrating MongooseIM with our API. MongooseIM, a chat tool provided by Erlang Solutions, sends messages to Kafka. We integrated our microservices to listen for these messages and process them accordingly. Additionally, developed all necessary APIs for the front end to manage settings and display images. Technology used: Spring REST service, mongo DB, redis, S3, eureka, config-server, feign, kafka, elastic search, oracle, kibana, Grafana, pinpoint, Jenkins. Etc.

3. Project summary: python library to support microservice architecture. Roles played: Architect, Developer Team Size: 1 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to developing a Python-based library that provides functionality similar to Spring Cloud. In my spare time, I created this library to support registration with Eureka, fetching data from a config server, providing an actuator health endpoint, and communicating with other APIs using Eureka (similar to Feign). Technology used: Python, FLASK, threading, eureka, config-server

4. Project summary: We planned, developed, and deployed a microservices architecture. As an initial step, we implemented and deployed a Discovery Server,

Config Server, and two APIs. Additionally, we integrated Graylog for distributed log tracing, SBA for API status monitoring, and Jenkins for CI/CD. Roles played: Architect, Developer Team Size: 3 in Designing Responsibilities: Active contribution Microservice integration to CICD pipeline for deployment. Technology used: Spring boot, Eureka, Config-server, github, SBA, Feign client, spring WEB MVC REST API, graylog. Log4j, Jenkins, NGINX, spring sleuth, S3, python, EC2.

Team Size: 1 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to upgrading the build tool for the application from ANT to Gradle, ensuring compatibility with dependencies, database drivers, and other tools.

www.indianeagle.com

It is an online travel agency and REST service provider for other OTAs, primarily serving US NRIs who book flight tickets. The platform employs contemporary technologies to ensure a superior user experience and high performance.

1. Project summary: Indian Eagle web application was a monolithic application, any changes in it leads to re-deployment of the entire application. So it’s tech and management team decided to change it to various rest sub modules and manage it using microservice architecture. Roles played: Developer Team Size: 5 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to configuring Netflix technologies to manage communication between newly created RESTful sub-modules and to expose them on the web. Additionally, set up CI/CD pipelines for the automated deployment of all modules to AWS cloud servers. Technology used: Spring boot, Eureka, Zuul, Ribbon, Feign, Hystrix, Turbine, Zipkin, jenkin, ELK, Docker

2. Project summary: The Indian Eagle web application was initially an online OTA platform, but management decided to expand its role to include providing REST services to other OTAs. We developed various REST modules to expose the same business functionalities with JSON responses. Roles played: Task lead Team Size: 7 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to configuring Ratpack to handle all requests in a non-blocking mode and assisted the team in converting the existing

Java application to a new REST application in Groovy, ensuring that the existing business logic remained unchanged. Technology used: Spring boot, ratpack, netty, groovy, Spring config server, Spring security, Spock, Cassandra, Mongo DB, Gradle

3. Project summary: Indian Eagle had a mobile website built with HTML and JavaScript that was not supported on many of the latest mobile devices. To address this, our tech team decided to redevelop the mobile site as an Angular single-page application, utilizing the new REST modules that were developed. Roles played: Developer Team Size: 3 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to developing various pages and pop-ups for the Angular application in collaboration with the UI team, and integrated them to communicate with the newly created REST applications. Technology used: Angular2, node js, Angular cli.

www.ieagle.com

It is an online travel agency and a subsidiary of Indian Eagle, focusing on

travelers from Middle Eastern countries who wish to book their flight tickets.

1. Project summary: The iEagle web application was originally developed using Struts2 and JSP. Due to security vulnerabilities, our tech team decided to migrate to Spring Web MVC with Thymeleaf as the view technology. Roles played: Developer Team Size : 5 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to converting all Struts2 actions to the appropriate Spring controllers, implementing proper interceptors and advice. Also created HTML pages using Thymeleaf for the new UI design. Technology used: Spring MVC, Thymleaf, Maven, Groovy, Spring AOP, Cassandra, Memcached

www.itools.igaruda.com

It is an internal tool (website) used by customer care executives and managers to process bookings and analyze reports, aimed at enhancing business operations.

1. Project summary: As iTools.IGaruda is an internal portal for managing both Indian Eagle and iEagle bookings, the management team requires various reports to track customer activity, sales, agents, phone calls, and more. Roles played: Developer Team Size: 2 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to building a report that details agent performance based on metrics such as the number of requests handled, login

time, leave records, and feedback from customers and management. Also developed a report to track the number of missed calls by agents and customers, including how many of these calls were handled within the valid time period. Technology used: Struts2, ring central, mysql, jquery, css

Education

Master of Computer Application (2014) from Trident academy of creative technology, Odisha affiliated to BPUT with 81%.

Bachelor of Computer Application (2011) from Bhadrak Autonomous college, Odisha affiliated to FMU with 68%. Intermediate from Gopabandhu Choudhury College, Odisha (2008) with 51%.

● SSC from Suryanaryan High School, Orissa (2006) with 57%.

www.indianeagle.com
It is an online travel agency and REST service provider for other OTAs, primarily serving US NRIs who book flight tickets. The platform employs contemporary technologies to ensure a superior user experience and high performance.
1. Project summary: Indian Eagle web application was a monolithic application, any changes in it leads to re-deployment of the entire application. So it’s tech and management team decided to change it to various rest sub modules and manage it using microservice architecture. Roles played: Developer Team Size: 5 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to configuring Netflix technologies to manage communication between newly created RESTful sub-modules and to expose them on the web. Additionally, set up CI/CD pipelines for the automated deployment of all modules to AWS cloud servers. Technology used: Spring boot, Eureka, Zuul, Ribbon, Feign, Hystrix, Turbine, Zipkin, jenkin, ELK, Docker
2. Project summary: The Indian Eagle web application was initially an online OTA platform, but management decided to expand its role to include providing REST services to other OTAs. We developed various REST modules to expose the same business functionalities with JSON responses. Roles played: Task lead Team Size: 7 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to configuring Ratpack to handle all requests in a non-blocking mode and assisted the team in converting the existing
Java application to a new REST application in Groovy, ensuring that the existing business logic remained unchanged. Technology used: Spring boot, ratpack, netty, groovy, Spring config server, Spring security, Spock, Cassandra, Mongo DB, Gradle
3. Project summary: Indian Eagle had a mobile website built with HTML and JavaScript that was not supported on many of the latest mobile devices. To address this, our tech team decided to redevelop the mobile site as an Angular single-page application, utilizing the new REST modules that were developed. Roles played: Developer Team Size: 3 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to developing various pages and pop-ups for the Angular application in collaboration with the UI team, and integrated them to communicate with the newly created REST applications. Technology used: Angular2, node js, Angular cli.

Due to security vulnerabilities, our tech team decided to migrate to Spring Web MVC with Thymeleaf as the view technology. Roles played: Developer Team Size : 5 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to converting all Struts2 actions to the appropriate Spring controllers, implementing proper interceptors and advice. Also created HTML pages using Thymeleaf for the new UI design. Technology used: Spring MVC, Thymleaf, Maven, Groovy, Spring AOP, Cassandra, Memcached

Roles played: Developer Team Size: 2 Responsibilities: Actively contributed to building a report that details agent performance based on metrics such as the number of requests handled, login
time, leave records, and feedback from customers and management. Also developed a report to track the number of missed calls by agents and customers, including how many of these calls were handled within the valid time period. Technology used: Struts2, ring central, mysql, jquery, css
